name: CKAD25-AE / SCDR-K4

existing_sheaf_predecessor.kind: three-cycle constant-F2 cellular sheaf, 1-dimensional H1, manually fixed restriction maps, temporal Bayes correction did not beat exact Bayes

known_negative_predecessor.kind: learned unknown incidence under known cycle/XOR family failed strongest exact Bayesian test

hypothesis: A full F2 constant cellular sheaf on K4 with three independent triangle-cycle constraints can identify which one of six independently measured causal edge responses violates global consistency when exactly ONE edge is erroneous. An independent, actually witnessed two-vertex intervention validates the proposed correction; the original observed negative edge evidence remains immutable, but the corrected conditional prediction is cold-restorable from source-backed anchor data. This tests useful conditional native defect repair rather than ungrounded latent-state invention.
math: Vertex stalks and edge stalks F2, identity restrictions, C0=F2^4, C1=F2^6, d0(g) on each pair is g_i XOR g_j; rank(d0)=3, H1 dim=6-3=3. Three independent triangle cycle invariants root=0: sigma012=y01^y02^y12, sigma013=y01^y03^y13, sigma023=y02^y03^y23. Six single-edge corruption classes have unique nonzero syndromes (110,101,011,100,010,001). 000 is coherent, 111 is not single-edge-localizable. Two-edge flips can alias a different single-edge syndrome: MUST abstain/reject if independent vertex anchor contradicts repair. A nonzero H1 is an observed global-section obstruction, not proof of latent physical state.
source: One existing NativeCumulativeLearner v6 per seed source fits independently observed A/B/C causal laws 12 actions each, cold restores and preserves compiled numeric committees. Each prospective world has six independent intervention-observed edge XOR outcomes stored with SHA-256 source_ref in native slot12 (public action IDs masks 8-13; graph fixed and supplied). Two new genuinely observed vertex-response actions at the candidate pair stored in slot13 (vertex action IDs masks0-3). The native sheaf method reads ONLY stored rows and an event provenance join, constructs cycle cohomology and a proposal, never writes a corrected answer into either native source slot, and returns an ephemeral corrected prediction only when the paid two vertex anchors verify it. Restoring the same checkpoint must reproduce the proposal, classification and corrected prediction, without overwriting slot0 or A/B/C.
true_data: Four independent hidden vertex bits per world, true six edge responses are pairwise XOR; measured edge sensors are clean, exactly 1 wrong, exactly 2 wrong, or independent p=.05 sensor noise. A fifth negative regime is exactly 2 wrong edges plus independent p=.05 vertex-anchor sensor noise. Regime assignment is intentionally balanced 32 seeds x five episodes; regime, actual wrong edge IDs, hidden true vertex bits and never-witnessed truth are evaluator-only, never inputs to candidate or baselines. Structural graph K4, edge/vertex action IDs, edge-value alphabet F2 and validator interface are SUPPLIED, not autonomously discovered.
action_budget: Per 32 seed, native source fit 3*12=36 actual do outcomes shared as a parent cold checkpoint, per 5 prospective world strata x5 intervention-policy replicas (native, exact cohomology, fixed, random, exact Bayes with same two anchors as native) each pays 6 edge do outcomes +2 independent vertex-anchor do outcomes =8; no-repair is evaluation-only same evidence but no extra epistemic privilege. Total physically enacted source-free do outcomes 32*(36 +5*5*8)=7552, with 160 world truth tables and 800 charged policy-world episodes, 6 held edge-truth scores per policy-world=4800 truth-evaluations (only 160*6=960 distinct true edge bits). No withheld vertex truth passes into any native method. If an arm chooses no anomaly, it nevertheless expends the two anchors on supplied default edge 01 to match budgets. Science first-use protected owner worlds zero.
controls: Exact K4 cohomology repair from independently coded d0 and syndromes, same observed edge bits and same two anchors MUST exactly tie native on every episode; no native superiority claim. Fully marginalize over all 2^4 vertex states and all 2^6 edge-corruption masks under an explicitly frozen five-way mixture prior (clean/single/double/edge5/double_anchor5), separately account exact and 5% noisy anchor regimes, conditional on same two native-chosen anchors: strongest exact conventional inference control, does NOT use hidden stratum label. Fixed edge and seeded random validation policies get identical edge actions, two anchor actions and six held true edge queries; no-repair carries original measured edge report as benchmark. Perfect true vertex oracle for score only.

main_gates.native_custody: All frozen source snapshots and first-use/provenance hashes verified; existing original+learned A/B/C source committees byte-identical after any measurement or cold restore; actual two anchor do actions source-pinned; no silent deletion or invention of edge observations.
main_gates.cohomology: Independent rank d0=3, dim H1=3; 6/6 single-edge syndromes unique, 000 and 111 cases covered, all six single-edge errors localized and repaired by exact vertex-anchor consequences.
main_gates.main_gain: Across all 160 worlds, native six-edge held Brier at least 0.03 absolute lower than no-repair matched evaluator, and >=95% correct repaired edge in exactly-single-edge stratum. No corrected edge on CLEAN and on DOUBLE with exact anchors.
main_gates.noise_safety: On DOUBLE_ANCHOR5 worlds, false repaired (wrong edge) in <=5% of 32 cases (frozen stringent negative; fail scientifically if not met). Under EDGE5 sensor noise, don't invent unobserved causal state or overwrite observed edge ledger.
main_gates.strong_control: Native must tie independent exact K4 cohomology in all predictions/statuses, and its overall Brier <= fully marginal exact mixture Bayes Brier+0.05. Fully marginal exact controls get same observed actions/anchors, no oracle stratum.
main_gates.source_reproduction: Fresh original cohort 32 seeds once per OS after disjoint dev preflight, byte-identical source/results; no post-hoc tuning, no duplicate PR or prior original source seed reuse; mandatory final complete Linux/Windows regression/G29 source pin.
